label: scam
title: 'Microsoft' says your bank was hacked, hands you to the 'bank' (Phantom Hacker)
sources: IC3 PSA 230929: 'Phantom Hacker' layered tech-support/bank/government impostors

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Kevin from Microsoft Security. Your computer sent us an alert that hackers are inside your online banking.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh my goodness, what do I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm transferring you to the fraud team at your bank right now. Stay on the line and do not hang up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Linda, bank fraud department. The hackers are draining your savings. You need to move all of it today, before 5 p.m.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not tell the teller why. If they ask, say it is for a home renovation. The hacker may be someone who works at the branch.
